assertions.assertion: Code contains AddFrontend for 'admin' with MatchingPath '/admin' and CdnIndexHtmlUrl pointing to the CDN URL
assertions.rationale: It hand-rolls named OIDC schemes and path routing; there is no AddFrontend/MatchingPath/CdnIndexHtmlUrl configuration.

assertions.assertion: Code contains AddFrontend for 'portal' with MatchingPath '/portal' and CdnIndexHtmlUrl pointing to the portal CDN URL
assertions.rationale: No AddFrontend is used for the portal; it uses a second AddOpenIdConnect scheme and a redirect instead.

assertions.assertion: Each frontend has its own ConfigureOpenIdConnect with distinct client configuration
assertions.rationale: Distinct clients exist but are configured via named AddOpenIdConnect schemes, not per-frontend ConfigureOpenIdConnect.

assertions.assertion: Each frontend has AddRemoteApi or equivalent remote API proxying configuration
assertions.rationale: It provides equivalent remote proxying for each app: /admin/api -> admin-api and /portal/api -> portal-api via MapRemoteBffApiEndpoint.

assertions.assertion: Uses AddBff() as the base builder
